avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces tramadol levels; serotonergic activity increases seizure risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort or avoid tramadol; consider alternative analgesic

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic effects increase risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor for agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, hyperthermia

avoid_supplements.name: Tramadol + MAOI or MAOI-like supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Severe serotonin syndrome risk due to tramadol's SNRI properties
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; allow 14-day washout between tramadol and MAOIs

avoid_supplements.name: SAMe
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic activity; increased seizure risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on serotonin syndrome symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase tramadol levels and adverse effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects (dizziness, nausea); consider dose adjustment if concurrent use necessary

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive CNS depressant effects at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use standard supplemental doses; counsel on dizziness risk

caution_supplements.name: Valerian root
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive sedation; avoid during activities requiring alertness

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases tramadol plasma concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit products; consider alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods)
caution_foods.mechanism: Tramadol's weak MAOI-like activity may potentiate hypertensive response
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake; monitor blood pressure; educate on hypertensive crisis symptoms

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression increases sedation and seizure risk
caution_foods.action: Advise limiting or avoiding alcohol; warn against driving/operating machinery

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia) and seizure activity, especially with CYP2D6 inhibitor co-medications. Counsel on increased fall/overdose risk with concurrent CNS depressants and avoid abrupt discontinuation due to withdrawal potential.
